func autolinkUrls(text: string): string {....raises: [], tags: [], forbids: [].}
Wrap bare http(s) URLs in angle brackets so nmark's built-in inline autolink renders them as <a> tags with the URL as both text and href. Skips fenced code blocks, inline code spans, markdown link/image destinations, and HTML tags.
